  "scripts": {
    "postinstall": "node scripts/prune-embedding-runtime.mjs && node scripts/prepare-native-assets.mjs",
    "prepack": "npm run build:shipped-history && npm run build:tui",
    "build:shipped-history": "node scripts/build-shipped-history.mjs",

    "smoke:compact": "node scripts/compact-smoke.mjs",
    "smoke:loop": "node scripts/smoke-loop.mjs",

    "smoke:patch": "node scripts/apply-patch-edit-smoke.mjs",

    "test:embedding-runtime:warmup": "node scripts/verify-embedding-runtime.mjs --warmup",
    "test:release-assets": "node --check scripts/verify-release-assets.mjs && node --check scripts/release-gate-test.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-native-assets.mjs && node scripts/test-direct.mjs scripts/release-gate-test.mjs scripts/prepare-native-assets-test.mjs scripts/generate-voice-runtime-manifest.test.mjs",
    "test:native-edit-wire": "node scripts/native-edit-wire-test.mjs",
    "test:release-critical": "npm run test:release-assets && npm run smoke:patch && npm run test:providers",
    "test:spec-advisory": "node scripts/run-advisory-spec.mjs && npm run test:spec-advisory --prefix apps/desktop",
    "test:session-transport": "node scripts/test-direct.mjs \"scripts/session-transport/*.test.mjs\" scripts/daemon-bootstrap-test.mjs src/standalone/session-runtime-inline-host.test.mjs",
    "test:office": "node scripts/test-direct.mjs scripts/run-office-live-tests.test.mjs src/runtime/office/office-runtime-contract.test.mjs src/runtime/office/office-runtime-com.test.mjs src/runtime/office/office-runtime-portable.slow.test.mjs src/runtime/office/xlsx-formula-audit.test.mjs src/runtime/office/xlsx-portable-snapshot.test.mjs src/runtime/office/office-runtime-pdf.slow.test.mjs src/runtime/office/office-runtime-design.test.mjs src/runtime/office/office-assurance.slow.test.mjs src/runtime/office/office-design-aesthetics.test.mjs src/runtime/office/portable-authoring.slow.test.mjs src/runtime/office/slide-quality.test.mjs src/runtime/office/authoring/pptx-brief.test.mjs src/runtime/office/authoring/pptx-receipt.test.mjs src/runtime/office/quality/render-air.test.mjs src/runtime/office/quality/pptx-deck-rubric.test.mjs && npm run test:office-approval --prefix apps/desktop",
    "test:office:live": "node scripts/run-office-live-tests.mjs",
    "test:office:compat": "node scripts/run-office-live-tests.mjs compat",
    "test:office:live:all": "node scripts/run-office-live-tests.mjs all",
    "test:office:render": "node scripts/test-direct.mjs src/runtime/office/pptx-skill-kit.slow.test.mjs",
    "office:icons": "node scripts/office/build-pptx-icons.mjs",
    "failures": "node scripts/tool-failures.mjs",
    "trace:llm": "node scripts/llm-trace-summary.mjs",
    "bench:office": "node src/runtime/office/bench/benchmark.mjs",
    "bench:office:contract": "node src/runtime/office/bench/contract-benchmark.mjs",
    "bench:office:assurance": "node src/runtime/office/bench/assurance-benchmark.mjs",
    "bench:office:polish": "node src/runtime/office/bench/polish-benchmark.mjs",
    "bench:office:deck": "node src/runtime/office/bench/deck-bench.mjs",
    "bench:office:quality:live": "node src/runtime/office/bench/quality-live-benchmark.mjs",
    "diag:sessions": "node scripts/session-diag.mjs",
    "diag:tools": "node scripts/tool-efficiency-diag.mjs",
    "diag:efficiency": "node scripts/session-efficiency-diag.mjs",
    "diag:sweep": "node scripts/session-sweep.mjs",
    "bench:session": "node scripts/session-bench.mjs",
    "bench:task": "node scripts/task-bench.mjs",
    "bench:corpus": "node scripts/routing-corpus.mjs",
    "bench:run": "node scripts/bench-run.mjs",
    "bench:recall": "node scripts/recall-bench.mjs",
    "bench:recall:strict": "node scripts/recall-bench.mjs --strict",
    "bench:tui-load": "node scripts/tui-runtime-load-bench.mjs",
    "bench:output-style": "node scripts/output-style-bench.mjs",
    "bench:session-context": "node scripts/session-context-bench.mjs",
    "bench:session-transport": "node scripts/session-transport-bench.mjs",
    "bench:tool-overhead": "node scripts/tool-overhead-microbench.mjs",
    "bench:search-tools": "node scripts/tool-search-bench.mjs",
    "bench:io-tools": "node scripts/tool-io-bench.mjs",
    "bench:internal-comms": "node scripts/internal-comms-bench.mjs",
    "audit:models": "node scripts/model-catalog-audit.mjs",
    "patch:replay": "node scripts/patch-replay.mjs",
    "build:tui": "node scripts/build-tui.mjs",
    "build:local": "npm run build:fast --prefix apps/desktop",
    "deploy:local": "npm run update:dev:fast --prefix apps/desktop",
    "deploy:vps": "pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/deploy-remote.ps1",

    "release:patch": "gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main -f bump=patch -f native=auto",
    "release:minor": "gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main -f bump=minor -f native=auto",
    "release:major": "gh workflow run deploy.yml --ref main -f bump=major -f native=auto",
    "tidy:engines:sync": "node scripts/tidy/sync-engines-manifest.mjs",
